ops.text: general pack stops.py stop_unverified_task blocked a lane's TaskStop on its own Monitor task while allowing three others in the same session. Session bc727d2f-022a-4d96-ae07-dc279dc56b98 (comms-desk lane, cwd ~/.orca/workspaces/monorepo/monorepo/comms-desk-base, Claude Code 2.1.296), 2026-10-12. Blocked: TaskStop({task_id: bayx1p4j5}) at 22:08:48Z, transcript event 937. Hook message verbatim: 'PreToolUse:TaskStop hook error: BLOCKED: `TaskStop` on task `bayx1p4j5` cannot be verified as a disposable shell task rather than a workflow, agent, or teammate session, its own children included. Let it finish, ask the root session to stop it, or have the owner name it in a cc-notes answer for a later session.' plus hook_system_message 'sessions: Stop only a teammate this agent spawned, by its <name>@session-<id> task id, or a background shell this agent started, or have the owner name the task id in a cc-notes answer before the stopping session starts.' bayx1p4j5 was the lane's own Monitor: event 127 at 21:40:16Z, Monitor({command: 'cd .../limpet && cci watch --drive juan-alvarado-11-11-am-zesty-octopus --reader comms-desk --cursor comms-desk --width 600 2>&1'}), result 'Monitor started (task bayx1p4j5' at event 138. Allowed in the same session: bcrzurem1 (started ev 339 21:43:44Z, stopped ev 543 21:59:05Z), beu48s1uw (ev 559 -> ev 907 22:07:51Z), bhcbq0qa6 (ev 913 -> ev 1063 22:17:16Z), all Monitors on a zsh ledger-watch.sh. Differences to test: bayx1p4j5 was launched in a parallel batch with another Monitor (ev 126 cc-slack watch, task bvmoowikt) in the session's first minute, its start sat ~800 events and 28 min before the stop versus 8-16 min for the allowed three, it had delivered task-notification events, and the TaskStop shared a parallel batch with a new Monitor launch (ev 938). The lane worked around it by letting the watch expire at 22:10:18Z, receiving duplicate records for 2 min. Filed by lane tool-comms-papercuts from monorepo papercut 667 item 3; capt-hook left unchanged.
